response.text:
I can do that — but cancelling a calendar event and notifying attendees is a destructive, visible action, so I need a quick confirmation and one detail before I proceed.

Please confirm (or tell me which you want me to do):

1) Do you want me to find and cancel the event called “Client Review” scheduled tomorrow (2026-07-14) on your calendar, or do you mean a different event? If there are multiple “client review” events, I’ll list them and wait for you to pick one.  
2) Should I notify all attendees when cancelling? (default: yes)  
3) Do you want a custom cancellation message or should I send this default:

"Hello — The client review scheduled for [date & time] has been canceled and will no longer take place. Apologies for any inconvenience. Please reply if you’d like to propose an alternative time. — [Organizer Name]"

4) Any additional instructions to include (reason, propose new date/time, or keep private)?

If you confirm (and let me know whether to use the default message), I’ll locate the event and cancel it and notify attendees.
